text.p: Bonds were gaining in sympathy with Italy and Spain. The positive tone is likely to be maintained with the lack of 10-year paper underpinning a two-digit spread with Spain, traders said.
"Everybody knows that the spread is too wide but there is not enough paper. The firm trend is likely to continue," said one fixed income trader.
"There is a large amount of 10-year bonds that is parked in investment portfolios...this is the (market's) support," added another trader.
Traders said that as long as periphery markets continued to gain, Portugal would remain strong.
At the shorter end, there was also little movement with players reluctant to make any moves ahead of the Treasury's auction of 20 billion escudos of three-year bonds on Tuesday.
